## English

Welcome!

My name is Tate Kihara (pronounced Tah-tay Key-ha-rah), and I am an Assistant Professor (*sennin-kōshi* in Japanese) in the [Graduate School of Media and Governance](https://www.sfc.keio.ac.jp/faculty_profile/en/list/gsmg/Tate-Kihara.html) (with a joint appointment in the undergraduate Faculty of Policy Management) at [Keio University's Shonan Fujisawa Campus](https://www.sfc.keio.ac.jp).

Sociologist and social demographer by training, my research examines international migration to and from Japan in both historical and contemporary contexts, with a particular focus on its relationship to social inequality. My works have been published in *[Demography](https://read.dukeupress.edu/demography/article/doi/10.1215/00703370-11370115/387961/Social-Mobility-Across-the-Pacific-An-Analysis-of?guestAccessKey=daafe79a-b043-467a-8674-f67e0f035638)*, *[International Migration Review](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/full/10.1177/01979183211041543)*, *[Journal of Ethnic and Migration Studies](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/1369183X.2021.1963219)*, among others.

Born in Kyoto, Japan, I have received my education in Japan, Canada, and the United States. Prior to starting my current position, I was a [Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS) Postdoctoral Research Fellow](https://www.jsps.go.jp/english/e-pd/) at the [Institute of Social Science, The University of Tokyo](https://www.iss.u-tokyo.ac.jp). I received my Ph.D. from Brown University in Providence, RI, and my M.A. and B.A. from The University of Tokyo.

You can reach me at tkihara![](/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/at.jpg){width="14px"}keio.jp

## 日本語

1991年京都生まれ。東京大学文学部行動文化学科社会学専修課程卒業、同大学院教育学研究科総合教育科学専攻比較教育社会学コース修士課程修了後、ブラウン大学大学院社会学研究科博士課程修了（Ph.D. in Sociology、2023年）。ジョージタウン大学マックコート公共政策大学院客員研究員、日本学術振興会特別研究員PD（東京大学社会科学研究所所属）を経て、現職（慶應義塾大学大学院政策・メディア研究科／総合政策学部　専任講師）。

専門は社会学・人口学。研究関心は社会階層論と国際人口移動。近年は、明治・大正期から現代に至る日本をめぐる国際人口移動を主な研究対象としている。

主な業績は *[Demography](https://read.dukeupress.edu/demography/article/doi/10.1215/00703370-11370115/387961/Social-Mobility-Across-the-Pacific-An-Analysis-of?guestAccessKey=daafe79a-b043-467a-8674-f67e0f035638)*、*[International Migration Review](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/full/10.1177/01979183211041543)*、*[Journal of Ethnic and Migration Studies](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/1369183X.2021.1963219)* などに掲載されている。
